Cover image, composed like an animated film poster: the child is the subject and FACES THE VIEWER, head and shoulders or waist up, the face large in the frame, eyes looking straight into the camera. The whole face is visible: never from behind, never in profile, never hidden by hair, hands or objects. A parent may appear only small or soft in the background. This cover framing overrides any wider framing asked for elsewhere in this prompt.

Emotional beat: wide-eyed and proud, showing off a new big-kid underwear

Camera: Child eye level, close head-and-shoulders shot, the face large in the lower half of the frame. Lighting: Warm soft morning light from a window on the right.

Feature-film 3D animated style: smooth soft-shaded stylised characters with large expressive eyes, rounded features, gentle subsurface skin glow, detailed knit and linen fabric textures, warm cinematic lighting, soft depth of field, rich but tender colour.
